fields.spec_version: Open NAND Flash Interface Specification Revision 4.1 (December 12, 2017)

spec_lineage_onfi.summary: Initial ONFI release. Asynchronous SDR data interface only. 256-byte Parameter Page; basic command set: Read (00h/30h), Page Program (80h/10h), Block Erase (60h/D0h), Read Status (70h), Read ID (90h), Read Parameter Page (ECh), Reset (FFh), Get/Set Features (EEh/EFh).
Added source-synchronous NV-DDR data interface (up to 200 MT/s). Added DQS strobe; CLK on the WE_n pin. Added Synchronous Reset (FCh).
Multi-plane operations (80h/11h, 60h/D1h). Read Cache Random / Sequential / End. Read Status Enhanced (78h) for per-LUN/plane polling.
NV-DDR extended to 200 MT/s timing modes; editorial clarifications.
EZ NAND option — NAND controller (typically ECC) stacked in-package; offloads lithography-specific management.
NV-DDR2 data interface (up to 533 MT/s). Differential DQS. On-Die Termination. ZQ Calibration. CE_n pin reduction with Volume Select (E1h).
NV-DDR2 timing modes extended to 800 MT/s. Extended Parameter Page signature 'EPPS'. Extended ECC Information section type.
NV-DDR3 data interface (up to 800 MT/s). Independent Data Buses. ODT Configure (E2h). Matrix termination.
NV-DDR3 timing modes extended to 1200 MT/s. DCC training (18h Implicit), Read DQ Training (62h), Write TX DQ Training (63h pattern / 64h readback), Write RX DQ Training (76h). Current revision.

spec_lineage_legacy_nand.summary: Pre-ONFI commodity NAND from Samsung / Toshiba / Hynix / Micron / Intel; vendor-defined CLE/ALE/WE_n/RE_n/CE_n bus with similar but incompatible command-set details (Read 00h/30h vs. 00h/0/30h, Erase 60h/D0h vs. 70h).
Samsung-led source-synchronous DDR NAND (DDR1.0, 133 MT/s) — alternative to ONFI NV-DDR; not pin-compatible with ONFI NV-DDR.
Samsung Toggle 2.0 (400 MT/s) — corresponds in spirit to ONFI NV-DDR2.
Newer Samsung-led toggle interface (≥ 800 MT/s); industry convergence with ONFI is partial.

key_changes.summary: Added source-synchronous NV-DDR (CLK on WE_n pin, DQS strobe) — first DDR NAND interface.
Added Multi-plane operations and Read Cache pipelined reads — first major throughput boost beyond raw page rate.
Added EZ NAND — in-package controller for ECC offload.
NV-DDR2 (differential DQS, ODT, ZQ Calibration) + CE_n pin reduction with Volume Select.
Extended Parameter Page (EPPS) + Extended ECC Information — supports devices with > 254 bits ECC correctability.
NV-DDR3 + Independent Data Buses + matrix termination.
NV-DDR3 extended to 1.2 GT/s + DCC / Read DQ / Write TX/RX DQ training commands.

backward_compat_traps.rule: All ONFI devices power-up into SDR data interface, timing mode 0. Host shall issue Reset (FFh) and only switch to higher-speed interfaces via Set Features (01h Timing Mode).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host that assumes NV-DDR3 from boot will fail to read Parameter Page (which is always emitted in the current data interface — host must read in SDR first).

backward_compat_traps.rule: Reset (FFh) returns to SDR. Synchronous Reset (FCh) preserves the active NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 data interface.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host using FFh to recover from a parity error will lose NV-DDR3 setup and must redo Set Features + ZQ Calibration + training; FCh avoids that.

backward_compat_traps.rule: First Reset (FFh) after power-on may take up to 5 ms; subsequent resets ≤ 500 µs.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host with 1 ms timeout on Reset will appear to hang on power-up.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Parameter Page bytes 254-255 carry an 8005h CRC initialized to 4F4Eh; host shall validate and try redundant copies on mismatch.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host that trusts the first 256 bytes unconditionally may use a corrupted geometry value, leading to misaddressed blocks.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Extended Parameter Page CRC (bytes 0-1) covers bytes 2..end (NOT including the CRC bytes themselves); Parameter Page CRC (bytes 254-255) covers bytes 0-253.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Drivers that use the same CRC routine for both pages must use different coverage windows.

backward_compat_traps.rule: After the second address byte of Change Read Column / Change Write Column, the host shall wait ≥ tCCS before the next data cycle.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Hosts that omit tCCS will read or write at the OLD column.

backward_compat_traps.rule: WP_n shall not transition during active Program / Erase or while Write Enable is active.
backward_compat_traps.trap: A glitch on WP_n mid-program can corrupt the page; system board must guarantee WP_n stability.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Read Status Enhanced (78h) shall NOT be used during or after Target-level commands (Read Parameter Page, Read ID, ZQ Calibration); use Read Status (70h).
backward_compat_traps.trap: 78h during Read Parameter Page poll will turn off the parameter-page output buffer and return undefined data.

backward_compat_traps.rule: WP_n disables Program and Erase but does NOT disable Read.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Hosts must rely on policy (filesystem, encryption) for read protection — WP_n is not a read barrier.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Factory-marked bad blocks have non-FFh in the first byte of the spare area of the first or last page. Erase of a factory-bad block shall fail (FAIL bit set).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Drivers that try to erase 'recover' a factory-bad block will see FAIL and may incorrectly retire a good block.

fields.version_naming_history_note: ONFI is managed by the ONFI Workgroup, jointly founded by Intel, Micron, Phison, Western Digital, SK Hynix, and Sony. The competing standard is the Samsung-led Toggle Mode DDR NAND (Toggle 1.0 / 2.0 / DDR4). At ONFI 4.x and Toggle DDR4 the industry has converged on near-identical electrical signaling but different command sequencing details; many modern NAND devices implement both for multi-vendor sourcing.
